name: Zekun Wang
title: PhD Student in Computer Science
bio: I'm a CS PhD student at **Georgia Tech**, advised by **Christopher MacLellan**, and currently interning at **Amazon**. I study **continual learning for deployment-time adaptation and generalization**.
shortBio: PhD student at Georgia Tech. Currently interning at Amazon.
researchStatement: I study continual learning for deployment-time adaptation and generalization.
researchQuestion: How can deployed AI keep adapting and generalize to what comes next?
researchVision: I want to build AI that keeps learning throughout its life: acquiring new knowledge, retaining useful skills, and adapting to unfamiliar situations.

I’m inspired by how people, especially children, learn so much from so little. My research on continual learning and compositionality explores how models can recombine past knowledge, adapt after deployment, and generalize to new problems.
personalNote: Outside research, I’m a semi-professional photographer.
